home.subtitle: Game programmer
about.p1: Hello! I'm a game programmer. I enjoy developing all kinds of AI and designing robust, scalable architectures. AI, procedural generation, and more broadly, algorithms are also areas I love to explore.
about.p2: My versatility allows me to work on every level of a game: architecture, gameplay, tools, optimisation, and asset integration. My philosophy is to keep my code clean and well-structured so that my colleagues can easily understand, modify, and use it. Learning about their disciplines is also something I like to do, it helps me design tools and systems that fit their needs.
about.p3: I recently worked on One Touch, a football-themed TCG, where the different tasks I handled there helped me broaden my skills. I am currently also working on a research project I started at ISART Digital about realistic crowd simulation in Unreal Engine 5.
footer.title: Get in touch!
footer.subTitle: Whether it's for a project, an opportunity or just to chat, feel free to reach out.
